title: Dirt Armor And Tools reforged
description: dirt armor and tools, adds tools, armor, a dirt biome and a suspicious dirt!
body:
**This Mod is a port of Charlie214's Dirt Armor And Tools mod.**

Dirt Armor and Tools Neoforged is a port of the OG mod and just adds the same things except
it doesn't have the experimental things like the dirt dimension and the dirt portal igniter.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Q&A (ultra cliche but yk very needed)
- Q: Can i use it on my modpack?
- --R: yeah but give some props to charlie214, not me
- Q: Will you update it with time?
- --R: it heavily depends if charlie even updates it
- Q: Will you add more things to the mod?
- --R: yeah it will be dirt armor and tools plus, i think i will make a version of the add-on for the OG mod

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

yeah that's pretty much it and the items are super op like the sword has 100 attack speed and 100 000 damage (woah **big** number!) and every tool and armor has 100 000 durability AND J.E.I. is recomended
btw it is my first (posted mod), i have made one some time ago but i didn't know how to post, i made it like ~2 years ago *update: yeah i remade it, it's called Funny additions and it has a brand new duplicator, it's on Forge 1.20.1 and requires the original Dirt Armor and Tools.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This mod features:
- Dirt Ingot (made by cooking dirt in a furnace)
- Dirt Sword
- Dirt Shovel
- Dirt Axe
- Dirt Pickaxe
- Dirt Hoe
- Dirt Shield
- Dirt Bow
- Definetly non-suspicious dirt
- A Dirt Biome

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

"oh why would i want to download this silly mod?" because it is very fun, the tools are super useful and will help you get OP quick, i use it myself and it is perfect!
